mapper.select: SELECT h.id,T.code, T.shop_name, G.sku_no, G.msku, h.receive_qty::VARCHAR receive_qty, TO_CHAR(h.receive_date , 'YYYY-MM-DD') receive_date FROM fba_shipment T LEFT JOIN fba_shipment_detail G ON T.ID = G.main_id left join fba_shipment_receive h on g.id = h.detail_id
SELECT count(h.id) FROM fba_shipment T LEFT JOIN fba_shipment_detail G ON T.ID = G.main_id left join fba_shipment_receive h on g.id = h.detail_id
